name: Paola Carvajal
headline: Operations Strategy & Transformation Leader
summary: Operations and supply chain strategy leader with 15+ years of experience driving performance improvement, operating-model transformation and enterprise change across consulting, manufacturing, automotive, technology, retail and consumer products. At PwC, leads multi-workstream programs for Fortune 500 clients, combining operations strategy, PMO governance, transition management, process optimization, analytics, automation and team leadership.
summary_detail: Experience includes leadership of PepsiCo's cross-functional remediation and stabilization program; the Duracell Controllership knowledge-transfer transition from Miami to Costa Rica; supply chain strategy for Lennar; global PMO programs for Google and H&M; and co-development of an Amazon Connect/AWS operating model and value case.

projects.title: UCX PMF CDMX Remediation & Stabilization
bullets: Led a 10-FTE cross-functional team across incident remediation, Salesforce case management, customer support, process optimization, training, knowledge management, and operational governance for PepsiCo's regional support organization.
Led the remediation strategy for 2,700+ ServiceNow incidents and 900+ Salesforce cases, reducing a significant legacy backlog while maintaining operational continuity and service performance.

Expanded the team's mandate from backlog remediation into inbound customer support, Salesforce operations, training development, and process governance across Mexico and US support organizations; transitioned the operation from a 10-FTE remediation model to a lean 5-FTE steady-state model.
Established governance processes, dashboards, KPIs, leadership cadences, and decision routines used to manage priorities, quality, risks, and performance.
Helped lead the POAF automation framework, translating repetitive operational pain points into process maps, requirements, testing priorities, and a scalable automation roadmap.

Coach and develop team members through structured feedback and quality review; formally mentored three Associates and supported development of a team member whose performance contributed to a promotion case.
Secured two consecutive contract extensions based on delivery performance and generated a cross-engagement referral after the client sponsor recommended the team's solution to PwC leadership.

projects.title: Automated Outbound Puebla Sales Pilot
projects.note: Business case: modeled capacity estimates over 40 days
bullets: Co-developed the operations and technology strategy for an outbound-sales pilot using Amazon Connect and AWS, replacing manual dialing with a shared-agent operating model supported by progressive/predictive dialing and ML answer detection.

Built a scenario-based capacity and value model for ~1,000 target customers and a 7-agent team, modeling ~500-650 agent-hours of potential capacity freed in Progressive mode and ~900 hours in Predictive mode over 40 days.

Assessed Salesforce-AWS integration options, skills-based routing, Customer Profiles, compliance controls, scalability, and implementation trade-offs to support leadership decision-making and pilot design.
Translated the business problem into a phased roadmap, measurable value case, operating-model choices, and implementation dependencies for presentation to client and PwC leadership.

projects.title: Controllership Transition & Knowledge Transfer
bullets: Led the Controllership knowledge-transfer and transition workstream from Miami to Costa Rica, translating current-state finance activities into a structured transition plan, governance model, documentation approach, and handover framework.

Established the process taxonomy and unique task-ID structure used as the source of truth for KT planning; designed the workbook approach spanning taxonomy, daily calendars, team mapping, and individual training/test tracking.

Standardized SharePoint repository and folder taxonomy, document naming, and source-of-truth controls while coordinating training schedules, preparer availability, recordings, and cross-border dependencies.

Structured a reusable knowledge-capture model combining shadowing, transaction-level video tutorials, narrative guides, controls, dependencies, decision points, and common exceptions to support sustainable transition readiness.
Received direct PwC Partner recognition for expertise, commitment, and above-and-beyond support to the Duracell engagement.

projects.title: RegReady Program
bullets: Analyzed and mapped key provisions across ~150 global privacy and security laws to support Google's global compliance posture.
Participated in weekly steering meetings with senior legal counsel, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and actions for leadership.
Supported PMO coordination across implementation workstreams, helping maintain alignment, quality, timelines, and delivery follow-through.

projects.title: Resource Management & Forecasting Optimization
bullets: Led a firmwide process-improvement initiative to reduce manual resource-analysis effort, standardize forecasting workflows, and improve leadership visibility across decentralized data sources.
Designed and championed a centralized Salesforce-based resource-management solution and dashboards; aligned requirements and governance with Finance, Human Capital, and Tower Leadership stakeholders.
Recognized for innovation and impact through PwC's internal iRace 4.0 program.

projects.title: Supply Chain Strategy
bullets: Led an 8-week engagement to improve supplier performance management and procurement efficiency.
Conducted itemized invoice analysis to identify cost-reduction opportunities and designed supplier scorecards, KPIs, and a live-metrics framework for supply chain visibility and decision support.

projects.title: EDB Platform Program
projects.scope: Project Management Consultant / Acting PM Support
bullets: Co-led the global EDB Platform Program and assumed full Project Manager responsibilities during the PM's absence to ensure continuity.
Served as primary liaison to H&M Group's Global PMO and applied Agile ways of working to coordinate cross-functional teams, timelines, and deliverables.
Advised manufacturing companies on growth strategy, operational scalability, production performance, and financial optimization.
Developed market-entry strategies that achieved 70% revenue growth; redesigned production layouts and processes, reducing operating costs by 40%.
Led ERP deployment and aligned technology investment with organizational goals, financial oversight, risk management, and long-term sustainability.

Established and scaled Deceuninck's Mexico operation from the ground up, creating the infrastructure, team, operating model, supply chain, commercial processes, and governance required for a fully functioning business.

Built and led a cross-functional team of 10+ across operations, logistics, customs, and supporting functions; designed the end-to-end supply chain across procurement, warehousing, inventory, logistics, distribution, and import/export.

Negotiated a 30% reduction in warehousing costs, strengthened inventory control and supplier coordination, and implemented ERP/CRM-enabled operating processes; enterprise-system exposure includes Compaq, Commercial, Mycrosip, and Odoo.
Built and managed a portfolio of 57 top-tier B2B clients and achieved full operational profitability through disciplined fiscal planning, cash-flow optimization, and risk mitigation.

Strengthened B2B partnerships with Intel, Dell, and HP while improving market performance, financial management, personnel efficiency, and operating discipline through targeted restructuring initiatives.
Secured strategic clients including Grupo Carso, Mercedes, and Audi through commercial negotiations and relationship development.
Optimized international trade and procurement activities, improving cost discipline while maintaining regulatory compliance and supplier coordination.

Served as PMO for the Continental project transitioning operations from Schlemmer China to Schlemmer Mexico while managing end-to-end logistics, customer service, procurement, customs coordination, and supplier performance.
Led the operational transfer with minimal disruption and redesigned inbound/outbound logistics and shipment planning, reducing expedited shipments by 95%.
Managed a portfolio of 70 national and international clients and approximately 1,500 components across a complex automotive supply chain.
Developed sales forecasts and annual plans to improve inventory, purchasing, capacity, and cash-flow visibility.
Designed purchasing methodologies using ABC Analysis and Buy-vs.-Build, negotiated supplier contracts, and strengthened supplier decision-making and performance.
Directed customs and broker relationships, addressed quality claims through corrective-action plans, and implemented 5S and shipment-certification standards to improve reliability and execution.

recognition: Received direct PwC Partner recognition for expertise, commitment, and above-and-beyond client support on the Duracell engagement.
Recognized through PwC's iRace 4.0 innovation program for internal resource-management and forecasting transformation.
Generated a cross-engagement referral after a client sponsor recommended the team's solution directly to PwC Partner and Director leadership.
Formal peer mentor to three Associates; coached and reviewed team deliverables, including development of a team member whose performance supported a promotion case.
